## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete change and the member responsible for it.

## Contract and data

- API/schema/migration changes (or none):
- Update OpenAPI and Postman when the contract changes.
- Add a new migration; never edit an already merged migration.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] Relevant integration/E2E tests
- [ ] Loading/empty/error states and role/ownership checks when applicable
- [ ] No real credentials, tokens, or personal data committed
- [ ] Another member reviewed the change

Attach test evidence and UI screenshots when relevant. State checks not run.
